rating_note: UNSA Police Academy graduates begin broadly competent but below specialist level. Specialist academies may later raise or extend this package; those deltas are not defined here.

training_boundaries.psi: Every graduate is trained in Psychic Defence, but universal academy training does not make every graduate a psionic specialist. ESP, Telepathy, Psychokinesis, Precognition and Noöspace remain specialist skills unless acquired elsewhere.
training_boundaries.cyber: Every graduate can use secure interfaces and perform basic defensive/investigative infosec. This does not define or replace the deferred deep-hacking subsystem.
training_boundaries.combat: Every graduate receives officer-survival, firearms, restraint and basic tactical training. This does not make a graduate a SWAT operator.
training_boundaries.anomalistics: NHI and X-Risk knowledge use Know fields plus Investigation, Forensics and Perceive rather than a new universal Anomalistics skill.

standard_augmentation_capabilities: secure sensory streaming to authorized partner/controller/AI
platform_rule: Capabilities are offered through implant, wearable, contact/glasses, handheld or external-BCI forms where practical. Refusing invasive cyberware does not make the character unplayable.
equipment_note: This package defines capabilities and availability only. Numeric equipment statistics remain undefined.
